description: Computes one anchored step of one card, as compute_step does: verify_step is the earlier name of compute_step, served for this one version beside it, and takes the same arguments and gives the same answer, byte for byte. The name compute_step is the one that stays. On this open connection one address holds at most 1 physics permit at a time, and long work (a solve, a plan of runs or of solves, a run of more than 10000 steps, or a verification that computes one again) runs 1 at a time. A call that finds no permit or no place is answered "Too many concurrent physics tasks." and nothing waits: the same call sent later is answered once one is free. An answer is waited for 60 seconds, and long work is stopped there.

inputSchema.description: One anchored step. The shape of parameters depends on the pair: describe_card gives it.

card.description: The card of the pair, as list_cards names it.

domain.description: The domain of the pair, as list_cards names it.

from.description: Optional: a sealed run to start from, as run_trajectory takes it.

parameters.description: The step's inputs: the card's phase fields, its load fields and dt_s, each a number (a vector field is an array of three numbers), and no other key. describe_card gives the fields of the pair, with each unit and bound. A required field left out is refused as InputMissing, in a sentence that names the field, and a card the engine does not serve as UnknownCard; nothing is filled in.

name: verify_step
title: Verify step
